notes: ENDLUME STUDIO 8.56 render-isolation release, pinned to exact M1-gated candidate c12043d9660bc68c5cadc6f68e2385cfc969c11c. This release fixes the 8.55 progress rollback/hang by giving the strict one-image render exactly one HEVC VideoToolbox attempt and forbidding the libx265 retry that restarted progress around 60-70%. It restores the fast lossless pre-alpha Effects cache and background prewarm, renders the complete natural Effects cycle at 30 unique frames -> exact 60 CFR, then uses the zero-copy MP4 sample-table path instead of physically duplicating hours of video. The exact real Neon Drive FM batch full 56.355s Effects cycle passed on kirill-mac-endlume in 18.637s at 1920x1080/60 FPS; a real 30s warm master measured 10.11s and original-MP3 copy+seed measured 1.991s. Whole-track remains mandatory, so a song playing at 2h finishes completely; MP3 stays bitstream-copy, crossfade/normalization/ambient are disabled in the strict path; output envelope remains 400-700 MB without modifying media packets. VYRON files and unrelated UI/store files are frozen against the 8.54 base and all five VYRON tests passed. The previously approved transparent cyan-violet-magenta ENDLUME infinity icon is restored, without the black rounded-square frame. No other functionality is intentionally changed.
